title: Pear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='pearBody' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8e986'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#8cc63f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5a9e1e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='pearShine' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='30%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8ffb8' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8ffb8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='stemGrad' cx='40%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8b5e2a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5c3a12'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leafGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7edb4c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a8c1a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow under pear -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#2e5a12' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- pear body: narrower top, round bottom -->
  <path d='M50 22
           C56 22, 62 30, 63 40
           C64 50, 70 58, 72 68
           C74 80, 66 88, 50 88
           C34 88, 26 80, 28 68
           C30 58, 36 50, 37 40
           C38 30, 44 22, 50 22 Z'
        fill='url(#pearBody)'/>

  <!-- lighter highlight on left of pear -->
  <path d='M50 26
           C55 26, 59 32, 60 41
           C61 50, 66 58, 67 67
           C68 76, 62 83, 50 83
           C44 83, 38 79, 35 72
           C40 66, 46 56, 45 44
           C44 34, 46 26, 50 26 Z'
        fill='url(#pearShine)'/>

  <!-- subtle edge shading on right -->
  <path d='M50 22
           C56 22, 62 30, 63 40
           C64 50, 70 58, 72 68
           C74 80, 66 88, 50 88
           C54 88, 60 82, 61 74
           C62 64, 57 52, 56 42
           C55 32, 53 24, 50 22 Z'
        fill='#4a8a12' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M48 22 C48 16, 50 11, 53 8'
        stroke='url(#stemGrad)' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <!-- stem highlight -->
  <path d='M49 21 C49 16, 51 12, 52.5 10'
        stroke='#a87840' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M52 13
           C58 8, 66 7, 70 12
           C66 15, 60 17, 53 16 Z'
        fill='url(#leafGrad)'/>
  <path d='M53 14 C58 11, 63 10, 67 12'
        stroke='#2a6a10' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- leaf highlight -->
  <path d='M55 12 C59 9, 63 8.5, 66 10.5'
        stroke='#c8ffa0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- small belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='66' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#d8ffa8' opacity='0.25'/>
</svg>
